Student Score Distribution ℹ

About this figure
Stacked view: For each value of the aggregation dimension (e.g. rubric aspect), one stacked bar shows the fraction of evaluations scored High (green) / Medium (amber) / Low (red), aggregated across all student models in the current filter.
Average view: Grouped bars — one bar per student model per x-value — showing mean normalised score (Low = 0, Medium = 0.5, High = 1).
Tip: Switch to Stacked and aggregate by "aspect" to see overall rubric difficulty. Switch to Average and aggregate by "judge" to compare student performance across judges.

Teacher Score Distribution ℹ

About this figure
What it shows: For each teacher model, the distribution of student evaluation scores on items that teacher generated, broken down by the selected aggregation dimension.
How to read it: A teacher whose datapoints consistently yield Low scores may be generating overly difficult or ambiguous problems. A teacher with very high scores may not be creating sufficient challenge for students.

Judge Score Distribution ℹ

About this figure
What it shows: For each judge model, the distribution of scores awarded, broken down by the chosen aggregation dimension.
How to read it: Judges that award very high or very low scores compared to peers on the same rubric aspect may be miscalibrated. Use teacher or student aggregation to check whether judge behaviour is consistent across different teacher / student combinations.
